input.recap_relative_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
input.user_message:
Read the Session 3 recap at `Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md` and extract all meaningful scene events as structured event records.

For each distinct beat, fight, conversation, discovery, travel segment, rescue action, or confrontation in the recap, produce one event_record with:
- event_class (one of: conversation, travel, combat, discovery, transfer, ritual, betrayal, disaster, investigation, social_conflict)
- participants (use the known character slugs below — only include slugs that actually appear in that event)
- location (brief description of where it happens, or null if unspecified)
- outcomes (list of concrete results or facts established by the event)
- time_scope (use "scene" for specific session events)
- certainty (use "observed" for events directly described in the recap)
- event_name (short descriptive name for the event)
- evidence_id (set to the recap path: "Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md")

Known character slugs: karsemine, stafl, caelynn, ephanna, bonogo, baergrom, grishna, pippa, kirfan, bubbles

The recap has both a 'Big beats:' bulleted summary at the top and a longer prose narrative below that elaborates the same beats. Treat them as describing the SAME session — do not double-count. The flood rescue of Bubbles the Float Goat is a multi-step action sequence; each distinct rescue action is its own event. The opening 'Adventure hook' and 'Big beats' lines are GM scaffolding, not events. Extract 8–18 events. Do not invent events not described in the recap.

expected_events.event_name: Pippa drives party to StoneBridge with Bubbles the Float Goat pulling barge of kegs
expected_events.location: river dock and barge en route to StoneBridge
outcomes: Caelynn, Karsemine, Stafl, Baergrom, and Ephanna accept Pippa's offer of a ride to StoneBridge
Pippa is a bright and talkative Gnome obsessed with crafting and understanding beer
Pippa hitches up Bubbles the Float Goat to her wagon full of kegs and leads the crew to a dock and barge on the river
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Party helps Kirfan the elderly fisherman pull a stuck net revealing roof corner beams
outcomes: Party encounters Kirfan, an elderly fisherman whose net is stuck
Bonogo dives into the water hoping for a giant fish but finds the net has no fish
Stafl and Baergrom straddle the boats and pull the net to the surface
The net contained the corner beams of a roof — debris from a broken structure upriver
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Party arrives at StoneBridge and unloads beer; Grishna comps beer and board
expected_events.location: StoneBridge dock and River's Edge Pub
outcomes: Party arrives at StoneBridge and unloads beer from the barge
Storm clouds become visible as the party hitches up Bubbles and the barge
Grishna comps the party beer and board at the River's Edge Pub for their help
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Stafl writes and performs a song retelling the Wizard's Tower Brewery adventure, jamming with another bard
outcomes: Stafl writes and plays an incredible song that woos the town in the retelling of the Wizard's Tower Brewery adventure
Stafl jams with another bard who is part of the evening crew at the pub
Stafl demonstrates his superior song craft and bardic talents
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Horrible storm kicks up and torrential rain hammers the pub roof
outcomes: A horrible storm kicks up and gets worse
Loud drumming on the pub roof turns out to be a torrent of rain, not the bard
Pippa excuses herself to check on Bubbles
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Pippa screams BUBBLES! after a piercing yell from outside; party rushes out to find Pippa in flood waters
expected_events.location: outside River's Edge Pub in flooding StoneBridge
outcomes: Weeping is heard from another table followed by a piercing yell of BUBBLES!
Party rushes outside and finds Pippa soaked and panicked, gripping the front of the pub in rushing water up to her waist
Pippa babbles about a broken lead
Bubbles is found wildly bleating on a rock in the river, the river frothing with rapids around her
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Ephanna's first mage hand lasso fails — Bubbles bites and destroys it
expected_events.location: rickety dock above flooding river in StoneBridge
outcomes: Ephanna creates a mage hand and sends a lasso out to Bubbles on the rock
Bubbles panics and bites the mage hand, destroying it
The rope drops into the rushing water
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Caelynn fires ice bolts to freeze a platform around Bubbles' rock
outcomes: Caelynn desperately fires ice bolts at the river around Bubbles' rock
The ice freezes a platform connecting to Bubbles' rock
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Bonogo dives into the river to chase Bubbles; Baergrom loses the rope
expected_events.location: rickety dock above flooding river in StoneBridge
outcomes: Bonogo dives into the river with full trust in Baergrom to hold the rope
The rope is immediately torn out of Baergrom's hand by the speed of the river
Bonogo and the rope are swept downstream out of sight
Bonogo flows downstream and has a wonderful zen underwater adventure
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Karsemine casts Zephyr strike and runs the riverbank shooting arrows toward swept-away Bonogo
outcomes: Karsemine casts Zephyr strike
Karsemine runs down the bank shooting arrows at where Bonogo probably is
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Stafl rallies townfolk to drop nets across bridge flow ways and evacuate residents to the pub
outcomes: Stafl runs for help and gathers townfolk to set nets across the river under the bridge flow ways
Stafl bangs on doors and assists townfolk escape the flood
Townfolk gather at the pub on high ground
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Ephanna's second mage hand succeeds, lassos Bubbles across the ice path; Ephanna rides Bubbles
expected_events.location: ice path between dock and Bubbles' rock in flooding river
outcomes: Ephanna and the mage hand coax Bubbles to the lasso
The mage hand leads Bubbles across the ice path to the dock
Ephanna hops on Bubbles' back to follow after the runaway boats
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Stafl and Caelynn cut loose a dinghy with a lighted net to chase Bonogo downstream
expected_events.location: flooding river downstream of StoneBridge bridge
outcomes: Stafl and Caelynn cut loose a dinghy
They let the river take them after Bonogo with only a net with light cast on it and hope
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

expected_events.event_name: Bonogo rescued; party returns to pub; town safe and drying — saviors of Bubbles and heroes of Stone Bridge
expected_events.location: River's Edge Pub in StoneBridge after flood
outcomes: Bonogo is rescued from downstream
Wet adventurers head to the pub to find a damp but generally relieved, safe, drying town
Party collapses to sleep and wakes up the next day as heroes of Stone Bridge and saviors of Bubbles the Float Goat
expected_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
